Projecter positions as a Leipzig full service digital agency covering affiliate, performance, social, SEO and analytics for midsize and multinational brands in DACH and Scandinavia: every channel from one office. Its headline claim, over 60 Leipzig specialists and hundreds of client projects since 2008 within the Obsidian agency group, is a scale and tenure claim; the group's other sites sit in Hamburg, Copenhagen, Helsinki and Bosnia.

The sold mix leads with Paid Search, scored 3 on Google Premier and Microsoft Select Partner badges, SEA, AI in SEA and SEA internationalisation pages and a Maciag +300% SEA revenue case. Six core lines score 2: AI Search / GEO (a GEO page with LLM and AI Overview audit, plus a ChatGPT Ads page), Creator & Influencer, Data & Measurement (Web Analytics), Paid Social (Meta and LinkedIn ads in the performance offer), Retail Media (feeds and the Amazon, Zalando and OTTO marketplaces) and SEO. The affiliate page cites practice since 2008 and 60+ managed partner programmes. No proprietary product is listed; AI automation, B2B, CRO, content, email and programmatic score 1 with no evidence note, local and web build 0.

Its AI posture is a sales posture: GEO audits for AI Overviews and LLMs, early ChatGPT Ads setup, AI in SEA and AI consulting, plus AI search news roundups and 30 AI topic URLs in the sitemap; nothing describes agents or an operator bench, and the Horus read marks P6 absent.

The one dated move is the 2026 ChatGPT Ads launch, noting ads running in Germany since 24 Aug 2026; the record lists no news. Four open roles cover Business Development, Social Media Ads, SEA and Affiliate Marketing. No prices are shown, only a free initial call, so P5 reads unknown. Conspicuously absent: a case study newer than the Maciag Offroad page (dated 2020-08-21, last modified 2026-01-30), a proprietary tool, a client with described work, and a readable Transparency Center record.
